 Williamson back in starting line-up for Arsenal Women- only change from Wednesday
 Arsenal Women 
 Tim Stillman 
 November 1, 2026 
 4 
 Arsenal only make one change from Wednesday’s 3-0 victory over Benfica in the UWCL for today’s visit of Aston Villa in the WSL. Williamson comes back into defence in place of Elisa de Almeida, otherwise the team is the same. Frida Maanum is back in the matchday squad.
 So Misa starts in goal in front of a back four of Ona Batlle, Leah Williamson, Steph Catley and Taylor Hinds with Cooney-Cross and Stanway in the midfield double pivot.
 Alessia Russo plays in the 10 with Caitlin Foord and Geraldine Reuteler either side of Olivia Smith upfront.
 16.Misa; 22.O.Batlle, 6.Williamson(c), 7.Catley, 24.Hinds; 4.Stanway, 32.Cooney-Cross; 14.Reuteler, 23.Russo, 9.Foord; 11.Smith
 Subs: 2.Fox, 3.Wubben-Moy, 5.De Almeida, 10.Little, 12.L.Maanum, 19.Baum, 25.Blackstenius, 28.Borbe, 31.Holmberg
